proposal.reason: The substantive change is to CI validation infrastructure: dual-platform (M890P/810E) workflow execution, case generation/grouping/selection logic, scheduler/resource allocation, HPN SDK install handling, run-time device mapping, reconciliation/reporting artifacts, and associated CI test data/docs (including patch_omitted case-list JSONs). Other edits (like workflow build script adjustments) support this same CI behavior rather than introducing an independent build/workflow-policy module change.
